caption: The drawing depicts a folded quilt with a diagonal striped pattern in light purple and white as the background. The quilt is bordered with a green edge. The quilt features a symmetrical arrangement of floral appliqué motifs, consisting of green stems and leaves with yellow flowers filled with small orange-red dots. There are three separate yellow flower and green stem motifs along the bottom and left side of the quilt, and the upper right quadrant displays a square section with a circular arrangement of four stems radiating outward, each with yellow flowers and green leaves, intersecting a green and yellow ring in the center. The overall composition shows a neatly folded quilt, with the botanic designs contrasting against the pale striped background.
title: Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
